title: Amazon EBS Throughput Optimized HDD and Cold HDD volumes (st1 and sc1)
note: Lesson 3.1, K03: confirms st1's baseline 40 MiB/s and burst 250 MiB/s per TiB (500 MiB/s cap) versus sc1's lower baseline 12 MiB/s and burst 80 MiB/s per TiB (250 MiB/s cap), and that neither volume type supports being a boot volume.
